data.one_liner: Automatically hides the soft keyboard when tapping outside text fields or scrolling.
data.what_it_does: AutoHideKeyboard is a Flutter widget wrapper that automatically dismisses the soft keyboard when a user taps outside of text input fields or scrolls the page. It utilizes global pointer and visibility detection to manage focus states effortlessly.
use_when: You want to automatically dismiss the keyboard when users tap outside text fields
You want to dismiss the keyboard when the page is scrolled
avoid_when: You need a complex form state management framework rather than just keyboard dismissal
You prefer handling keyboard dismissal manually via GestureDetector at the scaffold level
strengths: Smart detection for taps outside TextField widgets
Supports multiple input fields on the same screen
Zero configuration required for basic usage
weaknesses: Requires wrapping individual text fields or containers
